entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: Sequence of 329 aa has 55.5% identity and 99.7% coverage to reviewed Aquifex aeolicus O67716; annotation supports EC 1.2.1.11.

entities.name: Aspartyl-phosphate reduction
observations: 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H+ ⇌ L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP+ (Rhea RHEA:24284); enzyme annotation describes NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation.
